reviews.text:
I have a busy minded dog, and a busy work schedule.

Hounds Crew have absolutely saved my life with providing a great service in picking up my pup who needs so much physical, mental stimulation and dropping her back at mine when I return.

The team are communicative, proactive and leave lovely photos on their socials including my pup and the lovely crew she's with day-to-day. If you need dog care this is the best place.
I cannot recommend the Hound Crew highly enough. The whole team were so friendly and took the best care of Bertie. They are super reliable, provide regular updates and post lots of great pictures.

Teddy my Cockapoo LOVES his daily walks with Hound Crew. Jana is reliable, professional and provides attentive love and care. I love seeing their adventures on Instagram and feel reassured knowing that Teddy is so well looked after having fun with his doggy friends on Hackney Marshes.
Couldn’t have found a better dog walker — or a better group of friends for my dog! Always friendly, reliable, and caring.

Hugo has recently joined the Hound Crew and very new to London and city life so I wanted to find a dog walker that could transition him safely and confidently into his new life. Jana and Gui have done exactly that and more. I feel safe knowing he is with them and I love seeing the Instagram updates. Couldn’t recommend them anymore!

Finding Hound Crew has been such a relief! I've tried other dog walkers in the past, but the experience was always hit-or-miss. With Hound Crew, it's been nothing but consistent, reliable service. My dog absolutely adores them—you can see the joy in his face and the excited wag of his tail when he knows they're on their way. He even sits by the window waiting for their arrival like clockwork!

The team is incredibly dependable, and it’s clear they truly love what they do and care deeply for the dogs they walk. I’d wholeheartedly recommend Hound Crew to anyone looking for a professional, trustworthy dog walking service. When we were moving house, we even made sure our new address was within their coverage area—we couldn’t imagine switching to anyone else!
Norm very much enjoys his Hound Crew. He’s always really happy to get taken out in his mini pack with Jana or Megan and comes home ready to snooze the afternoon away.

Our dog Sylvi has absolutely loved the walks with Jana and Tiago. They are really reliable and friendly, and super good with dogs. Sylvi is an energetic pup and the walks have helped her to get an extra outlet. Thank you Jana!!

We have had a completely positive experience in our first few months of Hound Crew. We love Megan (she is so entirely capable and warm) and we love our day off walking Mabel, on the left. It always comes around as a happy surprise. Jana has been very accommodating with us which we value greatly. Worth it.
